paragraphs.text:
You hear a buzz from a hollow beneath the bank where you 
stand. Hopeful that you have found others, but wary of the 
strange  sound,  you  creep  to  the  edge  of  the  bank  and  peer 
through a fringe of scraggly junipers.
Make a Sanity roll: if you fail, lose 1D6 Sanity. Then, go to 503.
